fields.fld-description-0clo: A keep on the eastern cliffs.

corpus.nameHelp: The corpus's name: a series title, or whatever ties these stories together.

fields.label: Kind
fields.help: What holds these stories together.
fields.reads: Fabula's index shows it.

fields.label: Status
fields.help: Where the corpus stands as a whole.
fields.reads: Fabula's index shows it.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: What the corpus is, in a paragraph.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else about the corpus.

story.nameHelp: The story's title, working or final.

fields.label: Status
fields.help: Where the story stands; Fabula's index shows it.
fields.reads: Fabula's index shows it.

fields.label: Form
fields.help: What shape the finished work takes.

fields.label: Audience
fields.help: Who it's written for.

fields.label: Target Length
fields.help: A planning number, in words.

fields.label: Structure
fields.help: The structure whose turning points seed this story's plot points.
fields.reads: Its turning points are the Plot tab's headings.

fields.label: Custom Slots
fields.help: Your own structure's turning points, one per row, in order.
fields.reads: A Custom structure's turning points, the Plot tab's headings.

fields.label: Threads
fields.help: The plot threads this story carries; one thread can run through several stories.
fields.reads: The Plot tab lists them.

fields.label: Brainstorm
fields.help: The stemmas behind this story, rota or tabula; a chip opens one on its canvas.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else about the story.

fields.label: Why
fields.help: Why you're writing this story.

fields.label: What If
fields.help: The idea, in a sentence or two.

fields.label: Logline
fields.help: Who, what they want, and what's in the way, in one sentence.

fields.label: Theme Statement
fields.help: What the story argues.
fields.reads: The Meaning tab opens with it.

fields.label: Themes
fields.help: The themes and motifs it works with; the Meaning tab lists them.
fields.reads: The Meaning tab lists them.

fields.label: Central Conflict
fields.help: The struggle the story turns on.

fields.label: Conflict Kinds
fields.help: What the conflict sets its people against.

fields.label: Stakes
fields.help: What's lost if they fail.

fields.label: Synopsis
fields.help: A summary of the plot, for planning.

fields.label: Genre
fields.help: The story's main genre.

fields.label: Subgenre
fields.help: Narrower than the genre, in your words.

fields.label: Tone
fields.help: The feel you're aiming for.

fields.label: Reader Expectations
fields.help: What the genre promises its readers.

fields.label: Expected Moments
fields.help: The scenes readers of the genre wait for, and where they land; one per row.

subfields.label: Moment
subfields.help: A scene readers of the genre wait for.

fields.label: Comparable Titles
fields.help: Works like this one, one per row.

subfields.label: Title
subfields.help: A book, film, or game like this story.

subfields.label: Why
subfields.help: What it shares with this story.

fields.label: Point of View
fields.help: The point of view the story is told from.

fields.label: Tense
fields.help: The tense it's told in.

fields.label: Narrative Distance
fields.help: How close the telling stays to a character's thoughts.

fields.label: Reliability
fields.help: Whether the narration can be trusted.

fields.label: Narrators
fields.help: Whose eyes the story uses.

fields.label: POV Plan
fields.help: How a story with several narrators divides between them.

fields.label: Voice & Style
fields.help: Diction, rhythm, and the rules you're keeping.

fields.label: Time Period
fields.help: When it's set, as the story names it.

fields.label: Story Timespan
fields.help: When it happens, in your calendar.

fields.label: Places
fields.help: Where it happens.

fields.label: Rules in Play
fields.help: The systems and powers that shape what can happen.

fields.label: Arena
fields.help: How the setting makes or limits trouble.

fields.label: Sensory Palette
fields.help: The sights, sounds, and smells to keep coming back to.

cast.nameHelp: The character as this story knows them; filled from the entry you pick.

fields.label: Character
fields.help: The world entry this cast record is for: a character, or a god or other being.
fields.reads: A cast record is this entry, in this story.

fields.label: Importance
fields.help: How large a part they play in this story.
fields.reads: The People tab orders the cast by it.

fields.label: First Appears
fields.help: The scene they first turn up in.

fields.label: Role
fields.help: The parts they play in this story; there can be more than one.
fields.reads: The People tab shows it.

fields.label: Belief Systems
fields.help: The faiths and philosophies they hold.

fields.label: Motive
fields.help: Why they act; for an antagonist, the aims.

fields.label: Fear
fields.help: Their vulnerabilities.

fields.label: Voice
fields.help: How they sound: diction, rhythm, tells.

fields.label: Beliefs & Ideals
fields.help: What they believe and stand for, in their own terms.

fields.label: Secrets
fields.help: What the reader learns late, or never.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else about them in this story.

arc.nameHelp: A name for the arc, such as "Mira's fall".

fields.label: Cast
fields.help: Whose arc this is; there can be more than one.
fields.reads: The People tab names whose arc it is.

fields.label: Arc Type
fields.help: The shape of the change.
fields.reads: The People tab shows it.

fields.label: Status
fields.help: Where the arc stands in your plan.
fields.reads: The People tab shows it.

fields.label: Want
fields.help: The external goal.

fields.label: Need
fields.help: The internal need.

fields.label: Lie
fields.help: The misbelief standing in the need's way.

fields.label: Truth
fields.help: What answers the lie.

fields.label: Start State
fields.help: Who they are when the arc begins.

fields.label: End State
fields.help: Who they are when it ends.

fields.label: Turning Points
fields.help: Where the arc turns, and how; one per row.
fields.reads: The timeline marks them.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else about the arc.

relationship.nameHelp: A name for the pair, such as "Mira and Tomas".

fields.label: Cast A
fields.help: One side of the relationship.
fields.reads: The People tab names the pair from it.

fields.label: Cast B
fields.help: The other side.
fields.reads: The People tab names the pair from it.

fields.label: Kind
fields.help: What kind of bond it is; there can be more than one.
fields.reads: The People tab shows it.

fields.label: Starts As
fields.help: Where the two stand at the start.

fields.label: Ends As
fields.help: Where they stand at the end.

fields.label: Turning Points
fields.help: Where it turns, and how; one per row.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else about the two of them.

plotPoint.nameHelp: Its name; one added under a slot without a title takes the slot's name.

fields.label: Slot
fields.help: The turning point in the story's structure this plot point fills.
fields.reads: The Plot tab files the plot point under it.

fields.label: Delivered In
fields.help: The scene where it happens.
fields.reads: The Plot tab shows its scene.

fields.label: Threads
fields.help: The threads it moves.
fields.reads: The Plot tab's marks and a thread's page read it.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: What happens.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else about this plot point.

promise.nameHelp: A short label for what's promised.

fields.label: Kind
fields.help: What kind of promise it is.
fields.reads: The Plot tab shows it.

fields.label: Status
fields.help: Where the promise stands.
fields.reads: The Plot tab shows it.

fields.label: Setup In
fields.help: The scenes that make the promise.
fields.reads: The unpaid flag and the order of promises read it.

fields.label: Payoff In
fields.help: The scenes that keep it.
fields.reads: The unpaid flag reads it.

fields.label: Threads
fields.help: The threads it belongs to.
fields.reads: The Plot tab's marks and a thread's page read it.

fields.label: Promise
fields.help: What the reader is owed.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else about the promise.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.help: What this part does for the story.

fields.label: Summary
fields.help: What happens in it.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else about the part.

fields.label: POV
fields.help: Whose point of view the chapter keeps; a scene with no POV of its own takes this one.
fields.reads: A scene with no POV of its own takes it.

fields.label: Status
fields.help: Where the chapter stands.
fields.reads: The outline shows it.

fields.label: Target Length
fields.help: A planning number, in words.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.help: What the chapter does for the story.

fields.label: Summary
fields.help: What happens in it.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else about the chapter.

fields.label: POV
fields.help: Whose point of view the scene keeps; left empty, it takes the chapter's.
fields.reads: The outline shows it, and the timeline lanes scenes by it.

fields.label: Setting
fields.help: Where the scene happens.

fields.label: Goal
fields.help: What the POV character wants here.

fields.label: Conflict
fields.help: What's in the way.

fields.label: Outcome
fields.help: How the goal comes out.

fields.label: Turn
fields.help: What has changed by the end.

fields.label: Status
fields.help: Where the scene stands.
fields.reads: The outline shows it.

fields.label: When
fields.help: When it happens in story time, in your calendar.
fields.reads: The timeline places the scene by it.

fields.label: Participants
fields.help: Who from the cast is in it.

fields.label: Walk-ons
fields.help: Anyone in it without a cast record.

fields.label: Threads
fields.help: The threads it moves.
fields.reads: The Plot tab's marks and a thread's page read it.

fields.label: Motifs
fields.help: The themes and motifs it carries.
fields.reads: The Meaning tab's runs and a theme's page read it.

fields.label: Beats
fields.help: The scene's beats, one per row, in order.

subfields.label: What Happens
subfields.help: What needs to happen in the beat.

fields.reads: The outline lists and edits them.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: What you're thinking about the scene; never the draft.

fields.label: Applies To
fields.help: The world entries the research is about.
fields.reads: The Notes tab says what a note is about from it.

fields.label: Used In
fields.help: The scenes that need it.
fields.reads: A scene's research list reads it.

fields.label: Sources
fields.help: Where the research came from, one source per row.

fields.label: Findings
fields.help: What you found.

fields.label: Open Questions
fields.help: What you still need to find out.
fields.reads: Any text in it flags the note open.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else about the research.
